name: Find and Replace
description: Find and replace across the page, with VS Code-style ⌘D occurrence selection — the find & replace Thymer doesn't have yet.
instructions: ⌘F opens find & replace (reassign Thymer's native find-in-page on ⌘F first, or use the panel to rebind). ⌘D adds the next occurrence of the selected word to a growing selection, ⌥⌘D removes the last; Tab jumps into the replace box, Enter or Replace selected rewrites them. ⌘Z right after a replace reverts it. Rebind everything in: Plugin: Find and Replace.
author: @akaready
